source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 7, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader and cameras (the store aisle drawn by MuJoCo's Filament renderer, credit only for a complete delivery): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) scored credit 1.0 on each of the 12 episodes in each of its three wire runs at the selection (2026-11-23, tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: 36 runs, each with its own probe schedule, mean 1.0). In the graded order with the grader's own probe schedule, through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on Docker, `ale validate` measured the reference at mean_episode_credit 1.0 on draw 4's set with the same files but for comments and docstrings (validate-7897d0c9, 2026-11-23: 12 of 12 episodes at 1.0, no aborts, no simulation faults, probe pairs 578 of 578, the controller's own time 140 s of the 9000 s budget, the verify stage 2155 s; untouched 0.0); the validate of this set is named in the pull request. `value` is the credit's maximum; the measurements of draws 1 and 2 (earlier sets, earlier cameras, the earlier credit rule) are in tests/NOTICE.md and the pull request.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json, draw 7). full_at 0.98: one lane's facing lost in one episode (0.2 / 3 of that episode's credit, 0.0056 of the metric) still gives the reference reward 1.0, and two such losses (0.9889) would; an episode with a lane that is not correct earns nothing under the credit rule, and one such episode (0.9167) would not.
